### skirt noun (CLOTHING)

Add to word list Add to word list

A1 [ C ]

a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers some or all of the legs, usually worn by women and girls:

a long/short skirt

wear a skirt She wore a denim skirt and a white shirt.

More examples Fewer examples

  * The skirt fits tightly over the hips and flares just below the knees.
  * She was wearing a dreadful pink flouncy skirt.
  * She hiked up her skirt and climbed onto the bicycle.
  * a knee-length skirt
  * a gathered skirt


### skirt noun (ON MACHINE)

[ C ]

an outer covering or part to protect particular machines

### skirt noun (MEAT)

[ U ]

(also skirt steak)

beef (= meat from a cow) that is cut from the bottom part of the side of the animal:

There's an increasing market for the cheaper cuts of beef such as skirt.

Skirt steak is best medium-rare.

### skirt noun (WOMEN)

[ U ] informal offensive old-fashioned

a way of referring to women who are considered sexually attractive:

chase skirt He was still chasing skirt at the age of 85.

Ever since the day they were married, her husband was off chasing every bit of skirt he could see.

skirt chaser "The picture of him as a skirt chaser is inaccurate," says his long-term girlfriend.

More examples Fewer examples

  * She took the bank to court after being called a "bit of skirt".
  * He genuinely has no qualms about chatting up any piece of skirt passing by!
